title: Whole-cell modeling in yeast predicts compartment-specific proteome constraints that drive metabolic strategies
projectDescription: Our comprehensive model identifies condition-dependent and compartment-specific constraints that can explain metabolic strategies and protein expression profiles from growth rate optimization, providin a framework to understand metabolic adaptation in eukaryal cells.
sampleProcessingProtocol: We performed a series of experiments, using a wild-type S. cerevisiaer strain CEN.PK 113-7D, for collection of high-quality datasets of fluxes and protein levels.
dataProcessingProtocol: The resulting raw data files generated by XCalibur (version 3.1) were processed using MaxQuant software (version 1.6.0.16). The resulting MaxQuant output was then analysed using the MSstats package (version 3.5.6) in the R environment (version 3.3.3).

Whole-cell modeling in yeast predicts compartment-specific proteome constraints that drive metabolic strategies. Nat Commun. 2022 13(1):801
